name: galaxy-extension
description: High performance AI code completion for VS Code, powered by the native GalaxyEngine written in D.

galaxy.engine.path.markdownDescription: Absolute or relative path of the compiled `galaxy-engine` binary. When empty the extension probes `bin/`, `engine/bin/` and `out/engine/bin/` inside the installation folder.

galaxy.engine.autoRestart.description: Restart the engine automatically when it exits unexpectedly.

galaxy.engine.requestTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for an engine answer before the request is cancelled.

galaxy.engine.requestDebounceMs.description: Debounce applied to keystrokes before a completion request is sent.

galaxy.engine.modelTimeoutMs.description: How long the inline provider waits for a model answer when the local engine produced nothing.

galaxy.completion.list.enabled.description: Enable the classic suggestion widget with ranked candidates.

galaxy.completion.inline.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable grey ghost text inline suggestions. Requires `editor.inlineSuggest.enabled` to be `true`.

galaxy.completion.inline.mode.description: Which surface renders the top ranked candidate.

galaxy.completion.inline.minPrefixLength.description: Minimum number of typed characters before a ghost text suggestion is allowed.

galaxy.completion.inline.maxItems.description: Maximum number of candidates returned to the suggestion widget.

galaxy.completion.suppressInComments.description: Do not request suggestions while the cursor is inside a comment or string literal.

galaxy.completion.languages.description: Language identifiers the providers are registered for.

galaxy.service.endpoint.description: Base URL of the remote model and template service.

galaxy.service.apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the service credential.

galaxy.service.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout of the engine fetcher in milliseconds.

galaxy.service.maxRetries.description: Retry count for failed engine HTTP requests.

galaxy.logging.level.description: Verbosity of the Galaxy Engine output channel.

galaxy.ai.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable model powered inline suggestions. The local engine keeps answering instantly; the model result upgrades the suggestion when it arrives.

galaxy.ai.provider.description: auto picks the cloud provider when a credential is present, otherwise the local Ollama runtime.

galaxy.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model identifier. Fill in the middle models such as `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` for Ollama or a `/v1/completions` model name for cloud providers. Leave empty to keep AI disabled.

galaxy.ai.ollamaEndpoint.description: Base URL of the local Ollama runtime.

galaxy.ai.maxTokens.description: Upper bound for generated tokens. Keep it low so ghost text appears quickly.

galaxy.ai.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Low values produce predictable code completions.

galaxy.ai.stream.description: Ask the provider for incremental deltas so ghost text can grow token by token.

galaxy.ai.chatMode.description: Use the /chat/completions route with a single user message instead of the /v1/completions fill in the middle route.

galaxy.ai.promptStyle.description: fim wraps the code with fim_prefix, fim_suffix and fim_middle tokens. instruct uses a fenced instruction block.

galaxy.ai.prefixLines.description: How many lines of context before the cursor are sent to the model.

galaxy.ai.suffixLines.description: How many lines of context after the cursor are sent to the model.

scripts.compile: npm run engine:build && npm run build
